people.name: Lebanon
people.line: A mountainous region known for its cedar trees

translations.web: Isn’t it yet a very little while, and Lebanon will be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field will be regarded as a forest?
translations.bsb: In a very short time, will not Lebanon become an orchard, and the orchard seem like a forest?
translations.kjv: Is it not yet a very little while, and Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field shall be esteemed as a forest?
translations.asv: Is it not yet a very little while, and Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field shall be esteemed as a forest?
